name: Quality Concepts Manufacturing Inc
old_description: QCMI understands that partnering with a contract manufacturing company that you can depend on is essential to your business success. In choosing QCMI, you can be confident that your products will be produced with continual high quality, reliability, and on-time delivery.
about:
Quality Concepts Manufacturing Inc (QCMI) is based in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The company operates as a contract manufacturer providing a range of electronic and mechanical assembly services. While the founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available information, QCMI emphasizes its team as its core strength.

QCMI offers turnkey and consigned material programs, printed circuit board assembly, enclosure and cable design, mechanical assembly and box build, electrical testing, direct shipping to end users, and third‑party warranty repair services. The company also handles documentation creation and verification as part of its contract manufacturing workflow. No facility size, headcount, or production volume figures are provided in the source material.

The company does not specify particular industry verticals or named customers in the provided content. Its services are broadly applicable to any business requiring outsourced electronic and mechanical assembly, testing, and repair support.

QCMI states that its differentiator lies in its people rather than equipment alone, highlighting staff devotion to delivering continual high quality, reliability, and on‑time delivery. The company positions itself as a partner that goes beyond a simple equipment promise.
